title: Add RecipeHeroHeader view
description: Create RecipeHeroHeader.swift. The view renders a hero area at fixed ~240 pt height (~5:3 aspect ratio). It calls RecipeImageLoader asynchronously; if an image loads, it fills the area (ContentMode.fill, clipped); if not, it renders a .tint-colored block with fork.knife SF Symbol centered. A gradient overlay darkens the lower portion for legibility. The recipe title (Recipe.metadata["title"] or filename-minus-extension fallback) is overlaid at the bottom in white .title typography. An xmark.circle.fill dismiss button sits top-leading on a .regularMaterial circular background. Fixed height is preserved regardless of image presence.
acceptance_criteria: Hero area is always ~240 pt tall regardless of image presence.
Image fills the area with ContentMode.fill and is clipped to bounds.
Fallback renders fork.knife centered on a .tint-colored block of the same height.
Gradient overlay applied over the lower portion of the image/placeholder.
Title rendered in white .title font at the bottom of the hero.
xmark.circle.fill button at top-leading position with .regularMaterial circular background.
Dismiss button has an explicit accessibility label.
View delegates all file I/O to RecipeImageLoader.
